# Space Junk Collector

A simple HTML canvas game where the player controls a ship at the bottom and collects falling debris for points. Hazardous asteroids also fall; colliding with one or letting too much debris pile up at the bottom triggers game over.

<content>
1: // Simple canvas game based on IDEA.md
2: // Player controls a ship at the bottom of the canvas (id="game") and collects falling debris for points.
3: // Hazardous asteroids also fall; colliding with one or letting too much debris pile up ends the game.
4: 
5: (() => {
6:   // Starfield background
7:   const STAR_COUNT = 100;
8:   const stars = [];
9:   function initStars() {
10:     for (let i = 0; i < STAR_COUNT; i++) {
11:       stars.push({
12:         x: Math.random() * WIDTH,
13:         y: Math.random() * HEIGHT,
14:         radius: Math.random() * 1.5 + 0.5,
15:         alpha: Math.random() * 0.5 + 0.5,
16:         speed: Math.random() * 0.3 + 0.1
17:       });
18:     }
19:   }
20:   initStars();
21: 
22:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
23:   if (!canvas) {
24:     console.error('Canvas with id "game" not found');
25:     return;
26:   }
27:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
28:   const WIDTH = canvas.width = canvas.width || 800;
29:   const HEIGHT = canvas.height = canvas.height || 600;
30:   // Simple sound effects (placeholders – replace URLs with actual files)
31:   const sounds = {
32:     collect: new Audio('collect.wav'),
33:     explode: new Audio('explosion.wav'),
34:     gameOver: new Audio('gameover.wav'),
35:     bgm: new Audio('bgm.mp3')
36:   };
37:   // Enable looping background music and start after first interaction
38:   sounds.bgm.loop = true;
39:   let bgmStarted = false;
40:   function startBgm() {
41:     if (!bgmStarted) { sounds.bgm.play().catch(() => {}); bgmStarted = true; }
42:   }
43: 
44:   // Game state
45:   let score = 0;
46:   let gameOver = false;
47:   const debrisPileLimit = 10; // max debris allowed to rest on ground
48:   let debrisOnGround = 0;
49: 
50:   // Ship definition
51:   const ship = {
52:     width: 40,
53:     height: 20,
54:     x: WIDTH / 2 - 20,
55:     y: HEIGHT - 30,
56:     speed: 5,
57:     moveLeft: false,
58:     moveRight: false,
59:     update() {
60:       if (this.moveLeft) this.x = Math.max(0, this.x - this.speed);
61:       if (this.moveRight) this.x = Math.min(WIDTH - this.width, this.x + this.speed);
62:     },
63:     draw() {
64:       // Ship with a simple gradient
65:       const grad = ctx.createLinearGradient(this.x, this.y, this.x, this.y + this.height);
66:       grad.addColorStop(0, '#0066ff');
67:       grad.addColorStop(1, '#0033aa');
68:       ctx.fillStyle = grad;
69:       ctx.beginPath();
70:       ctx.moveTo(this.x, this.y + this.height);
71:       ctx.lineTo(this.x + this.width / 2, this.y);
72:       ctx.lineTo(this.x + this.width, this.y + this.height);
73:       ctx.closePath();
74:       ctx.fill();
75:     }
76:   };
77: 
78:   // Falling object constructor
79:   function createFalling(x, speed, type) {
80:     return {
81:       x,
82:       y: 0,
83:       size: 20,
84:       speed,
85:       type, // 'debris' or 'asteroid'
86:       update() {
87:         this.y += this.speed;
88:       },
89:       draw() {
90:         ctx.fillStyle = this.type === 'debris' ? '#0f0' : '#f00';
91:         ctx.fillRect(this.x, this.y, this.size, this.size);
92:       }
93:     };
94:   }
95: 
96:   const debris = [];
97:   const asteroids = [];
98: 
99:   // Spawn intervals
100:   let debrisTimer = 0;
101:   let asteroidTimer = 0;
102:   const debrisInterval = 60; // frames
103:   const asteroidInterval = 150;
104: 
105:   // Input handling
106:   window.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
107:     // Start background music on first user interaction
108:     startBgm();
109:     if (e.key === 'ArrowLeft') ship.moveLeft = true;
110:     if (e.key === 'ArrowRight') ship.moveRight = true;
111:   });
112:   window.addEventListener('keyup', e => {
113:     if (e.key === 'ArrowLeft') ship.moveLeft = false;
114:     if (e.key === 'ArrowRight') ship.moveRight = false;
115:   });
116: 
117:   function checkCollision(obj) {
118:     const withinX = obj.x < ship.x + ship.width && obj.x + obj.size > ship.x;
119:     const withinY = obj.y < ship.y + ship.height && obj.y + obj.size > ship.y;
120:     return withinX && withinY;
121:   }
122: 
123:   function update() {
124:     if (gameOver) return;
125:     // Spawn debris
126:     if (debrisTimer++ >= debrisInterval) {
127:       debrisTimer = 0;
128:       const x = Math.random() * (WIDTH - 20);
129:       debris.push(createFalling(x, 2 + Math.random() * 2, 'debris'));
130:     }
131:     // Spawn asteroids
132:     if (asteroidTimer++ >= asteroidInterval) {
133:       asteroidTimer = 0;
134:       const x = Math.random() * (WIDTH - 20);
135:       asteroids.push(createFalling(x, 3 + Math.random() * 2, 'asteroid'));
136:     }
137: 
138:     ship.update();
139: 
140:     // Update debris
141:     for (let i = debris.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
142:       const d = debris[i];
143:       d.update();
144:       // Collision with ship
145: if (checkCollision(d)) {
146:           score += 10;
147:           // Play collect sound
148:           sounds.collect.currentTime = 0;
149:           sounds.collect.play();
150:           debris.splice(i, 1);
151:           continue;
152:         }
153:       // Hit ground
154:       if (d.y + d.size >= HEIGHT) {
155:         debrisOnGround++;
156:         debris.splice(i, 1);
157:         if (debrisOnGround >= debrisPileLimit) {
158:           endGame('Too much debris piled up!');
159:           return;
160:         }
161:       }
162:     }
163:     // Update asteroids
164:     for (let i = asteroids.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
165:       const a = asteroids[i];
166:       a.update();
167:       if (checkCollision(a)) {
168:         // Play explosion sound
169:         sounds.explode.currentTime = 0;
170:         sounds.explode.play();
171:         endGame('Hit by an asteroid!');
172:         return;
173:       }
174:       if (a.y > HEIGHT) {
175:         // Remove off‑screen asteroid
176:         asteroids.splice(i, 1);
177:       }
178:     }
179:   }
180: 
181:   function draw() {
182:     ctx.clearRect(0, 0, WIDTH, HEIGHT);
183:     // Draw starfield background
184:     ctx.fillStyle = '#000';
185:     for (let i = stars.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
186:       const s = stars[i];
187:       s.y += s.speed;
188:       if (s.y > HEIGHT) {
189:         s.y = 0;
190:         s.x = Math.random() * WIDTH;
191:       }
192:       ctx.globalAlpha = s.alpha;
193:       ctx.beginPath();
194:       ctx.arc(s.x, s.y, s.radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
195:       ctx.fill();
196:     }
197:     ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
198:     // Draw ship
199:     ship.draw();
200:     // Draw debris
201:     debris.forEach(d => d.draw());
202:     // Draw asteroids
203:     asteroids.forEach(a => a.draw());
204:     // Score
205:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
206:     ctx.font = '16px sans-serif';
207:     ctx.fillText('Score: ' + score, 10, 20);
208:   }
209: 
210:   function loop() {
211:     if (!gameOver) {
212:       update();
213:       draw();
214:       requestAnimationFrame(loop);
215:     }
216:   }
217: 
218:   function endGame(msg) {
219:     gameOver = true;
220:     // Play game over sound
221:     sounds.gameOver.currentTime = 0;
222:     sounds.gameOver.play();
223:     // Optionally stop background music
224:     sounds.bgm.pause();
225:     ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.6)';
226:     ctx.fillRect(0, 0, WIDTH, HEIGHT);
227:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
228:     ctx.font = '36px sans-serif';
229:     ctx.textAlign = 'center';
230:     ctx.fillText('Game Over', WIDTH / 2, HEIGHT / 2 - 20);
231:     ctx.font = '24px sans-serif';
232:     ctx.fillText(msg, WIDTH / 2, HEIGHT / 2 + 20);
233:     ctx.fillText('Final Score: ' + score, WIDTH / 2, HEIGHT / 2 + 60);
234:   }
235: 
236:   // Start the loop
237:   requestAnimationFrame(loop);
238: })();

(End of file - total 238 lines)
</content>
